name: Barthel Index
description: 10-item scale measuring functional independence in ADLs (feeding, bathing, grooming, dressing, bowels, bladder, toilet use, transfers, mobility, stairs).
shirleySays: ICC 0.95–0.99. MDC: 10 pts. MCID: commonly >10 pts clinically. Normed in stroke, SCI, geriatrics, TBI, MS, hip fracture, cardiac rehab. Known floor effect in severe impairment; ceiling effect in mild cases.

scoring.mcidNote: >10-point change commonly accepted as clinically meaningful
